claim: UNESCO identifies Kandy as the last royal capital and the Temple of the Tooth as a major pilgrimage site; sacred and heritage functions are institutionally fixed to the city rather than a generic service that can be relocated without loss of meaning.
bounded_by: Non-transferability is an institutional inference from place-bound heritage status; it does not by itself prove that sacredness substitutes for weak economic endowments.
notes: Feeds comparator bridge; contemporary viability thesis remains U.
